card.text: A spiral galaxy 8.8 million parsecs away, tilted 55° to our line of sight.

sources.label: Tully et al. (2023), Cosmicflows-4, ApJ 944, 94; CDS J/ApJ/944/94, table 2 (distances of individual galaxies), PGC 46153: distance modulus 29.73 ± 0.02 mag

Wikipedia, "Messier 63"
sources.quote: Messier 63 or M63, also known as NGC 5055 or the Sunflower Galaxy, is a spiral galaxy in the northern constellation of Canes Venatici.

introduction.text: Its picture is the Sloan Digital Sky Survey's, with the Milky Way's foreground stars removed, laid flat on its measured disc.

sources.label: Sloan Digital Sky Survey; color HiPS CDS/P/SDSS9/color by T. Boch (CDS), cut out by the CDS hips2fits service
Wikipedia, "Messier 63"
sources.quote: M63 was first discovered by the French astronomer Pierre Méchain, then later verified by his colleague Charles Messier on 14 June 1779.

optical.title: M63 in visible light
optical.summary: Visible-light image, flat on its measured disc; depths are not measured.
